reason: I already paid a developer once and got a pretty website that brought me nothing, and now a small remote studio with one chemical client wants Rs 60,000 plus Rs 5,000 every month. The quote desk sounds useful for my IndiaMART and WhatsApp enquiries, but I've heard 'it will save you time' before.
objection: A website alone will not bring buyers, and I can't tell if this quote desk will actually understand my price list and my buyers' messy WhatsApp enquiries or just give me another thing to check and fix. Who do I chase if it stops working after they get their 70%?
would_change_my_mind: Let me speak to that chemical trading client, and let me try only the quote desk on my real IndiaMART and WhatsApp enquiries for two weeks before I pay anything big for the website.
